purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous parcel-geometry access review.
assessment: The city bureau documents a cadastral map platform with parcel and building-related functions. The public landing page returned HTTP 200; static JavaScript names parcel and cadastral list/data routes, while associated detail calls use a client-credential/access-token flow. No data API was called because the public-safe field contract could not be established without that flow; no geometry response verified.
registryAssessment: The official Huaibei Natural Resources and Planning Bureau describes the city cadastral platform as displaying cadastral zones and parcel information. Its static public map shell loads, but data routes in the frontend are linked to backend service calls requiring a client/access-token flow; no token or parcel endpoint was used.
